source: electron-builder's legacy AppImage toolset (electron-userland/electron-builder-binaries), downloaded by electron-builder 26.18.0
why: libindicator (GPL-3.0) is in usr/lib of both the legacy and the 1.0.2/1.0.3 toolsets; the licence rule (spec 8.10) forbids GPL in the package. libappindicator cannot load without it and serves only a tray icon, which this app does not have.
